[EN] Don't you think it's odd so many merchants have nothing to sell? They all say someone comes from Allemantheia to buy all their wares.

I don't like to sound distrustful, but...everything?
[ES] ¿No te parece extraño que tantos mercaderes no tengan nada que vender? Todos dicen que alguien viene de Allemantheia para comprar todas sus mercancías.

No me gusta sonar desconfiado, pero... ¿todo?
